# Notebook 10 -- Projection metrics for the H4 decomposition

**What this notebook does.** `DECOMP_00_anova.Rmd` needs one long-format table
with a complete `gcm x structure x tail_policy` factorial per catchment, metric,
SSP and future window. Nothing in the repository produced it: `LOWFLOW_00`
computes *skill* metrics against observations on 2001-2014, and `GR6J_30`
computes *structural divergence* on the same historical window. This module
supplies the missing **projection** layer:

1. reads the bias-corrected SSP forcings from `QED_50`
   (`data_processed/ssp/qm_corrected_<policy>/<gcm>/<ssp>/<tier>/<id>_<var>.csv`)
   for **both** pre-registered EQM tail policies (`linear`, `constant`);
2. builds Oudin PET (identical to calibration) and drives the catchment's
   **calibrated GR4J** (`data_processed/hyd/params/<id>.rds`) and
   **calibrated GR6J** (`data_processed/gr6j/params/<id>.rds`) -- same params,
   same warm-up rule, same PET, only the structure differs;
3. computes low-flow **indicators** (not biases: there is no future
   observation) over three future windows, and writes the factor-tagged long
   table `data_processed/decomp/input_metrics.csv`.

**Why indicators and not the LOWFLOW_00 bias metrics.** Skill metrics need
observed discharge; projections do not have any. The decomposition instead asks
how much a low-flow *indicator* moves with GCM choice, with structure, and with
the EQM tail policy. Indicators stay physically interpretable and are never
blended (one ANOVA per metric, per AGENTS.md guardrail 5).

**Pre-registered design (recorded here, 2026-11-21, before any H4 result exists):**

| item | value |
|---|---|
| projection windows | `2021-2040`, `2041-2060`, `2082-2100` |
| archive gap | the SSP archive has **no 2061-2080 files at all** (66 of 86 years per combo, verified on `D:/Datasets/Download_CMIP/SSP`), so that period is excluded, never interpolated; the far window therefore starts in 2082 and is 19 years long |
| warm-up | **365 days immediately before each window** (2020, 2040, 2081) -- the repository-wide rule from `HYD_00`; no warm-up ever crosses the gap |
| low-flow threshold | `dry_spell_days` uses each window's **own** Q90 (10th percentile, type 7): it is a persistence indicator and must stay defined even where future flows sit above the historical threshold |
| metrics | `log10_q95`, `log10_mam7`, `log10_meanq`, `lf_ratio_q95`, `dry_spell_days` (section 4) |
| factors | `gcm` (14; 13 for ssp245/ssp370), `structure` (GR4J/GR6J), `tail_policy` (linear/constant) |
| `metric_version` | `v1_proj` |

**Dated design note (2026-11-21, before any H4 result).** Two frozen-threshold
drought-exposure metrics (`lf_deficit_mm`, `dry_spell_days` against the observed
1981-2000 Q90) were piloted and **dropped**: in the pilot they were identically
zero for most cells, because projected flows sit above the historical 10th
percentile. A zero-variance response carries no variance share to decompose.
They are replaced by the threshold-free `lf_ratio_q95` (shape of the low tail)
and a window-relative `dry_spell_days` (persistence). This is a metric-design
decision made and recorded before the decomposition was run, not after seeing
an H4 outcome.

**Known and explicit limitation (AGENTS.md guardrail 7).** `HadGEM3-GC31-MM`
ssp245/ssp370 are not published on ESGF (`data_processed/logs/ssp_unavailable.csv`,
`gcm_scenario_not_published`). H4 therefore runs a **13-GCM factorial for
ssp245/ssp370** and a **14-GCM factorial for ssp126/ssp585**. Both are balanced,
which is all the ANOVA requires; the reduced set is never padded or smoothed
away, and `h4_gcm_coverage.csv` records it.

   line <- paste0(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), " | ", msg)

}

## 1. Configuration

```{r config}
dec_metric_version <- "v1_proj"
# Explicit, visible switches (same style as qed50_test_mode): production is
# TEST=0 / POLICIES=linear,constant. The knobs exist so a smoke test and a
# single-policy rerun never need a code edit -- and both are logged below.
dec_test_mode <- identical(Sys.getenv("DECOMP_TEST", "0"), "1")
dec_policies  <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("DECOMP_POLICIES", "linear,constant"),
                          ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
dec_structures     <- c("GR4J", "GR6J")
dec_metrics_vec    <- c("log10_q95", "log10_mam7", "log10_meanq",
                        "lf_ratio_q95", "dry_spell_days")
dec_log_eps        <- 0.01        # mm/day, log offset (same as LOWFLOW_00)
dec_q90_prob       <- 0.10        # exceedance 90 % -> 10th percentile
dec_q95_prob       <- 0.05        # exceedance 95 % -> 5th percentile
dec_spell_w        <- 7L          # MAM7 trailing window (days)

# The archive has no 2061-2080 files, so each window is preceded by exactly one
# year of real warm-up (HYD_00's rule) and never by interpolated data.
dec_windows <- data.table::data.table(
   window     = c("2021-2040", "2041-2060", "2082-2100"),
   start      = as.Date(c("2021-01-01", "2041-01-01", "2082-01-01")),
   end        = as.Date(c("2040-12-31", "2060-12-31", "2100-12-31")),
   warm_start = as.Date(c("2020-01-01", "2040-01-01", "2081-01-01")))

# quick-test mode: small, but still a full factorial per catchment
dec_test_ids   <- c("03002", "03005", "03008")
dec_test_gcms  <- c("ACCESS-ESM1-5", "CanESM5")
dec_test_ssps  <- c("ssp245")
dec_test_ncat  <- 3L              # cap on catchments in test mode

cat("policies  :", paste(dec_policies, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("structures:", paste(dec_structures, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("windows   :", paste(dec_windows$window, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("metrics   :", paste(dec_metrics_vec, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("test mode :", dec_test_mode, "\n")
```

## 3. Corrected-forcing inventory (gcm x ssp x policy)

```{r inventory}
# discover what QED_50 actually wrote; never assume a model/scenario exists
dec_scan <- function(pdir, policy) {
   models <- list.dirs(pdir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
   out <- lapply(models, function(m) {
      ssps <- list.dirs(file.path(pdir, m), recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
      if (!length(ssps)) return(NULL)
      data.table::data.table(gcm = m, ssp = ssps)
   })
   dt <- data.table::rbindlist(out, use.names = TRUE)
   if (!nrow(dt)) return(NULL)
   dt[, tail_policy := policy]
   dt
}

dec_inv <- list()
for (pol in dec_policies) {
   pdir <- file.path(ssp_dir, paste0("qm_corrected_", pol))
   if (!dir.exists(pdir)) {
      dec_log(paste("policy root absent, skipped:", basename(pdir)))
      next
   }
   ii <- dec_scan(pdir, pol)
   if (!is.null(ii)) dec_inv[[pol]] <- ii
}
dec_inv <- data.table::rbindlist(dec_inv, use.names = TRUE)

if (dec_test_mode) dec_inv <- dec_inv[gcm %in% dec_test_gcms & ssp %in% dec_test_ssps]
data.table::setorder(dec_inv, tail_policy, gcm, ssp)

cat("gcm x ssp x policy combos:", nrow(dec_inv), "\n")
print(dec_inv[, .N, by = tail_policy])
cat("distinct GCMs per ssp x policy:\n")
print(dec_inv[, .(n_gcm = data.table::uniqueN(gcm)), by = .(ssp, tail_policy)])
```

## 4. Low-flow indicators (guarded; every guard returns NA + a reason code)

Each indicator is computed **inside the projection window only** (the warm-up
year is discarded). `dry_spell_days` uses that same window's own Q90, so the
indicator is always defined; the other four are threshold-free. Because the
formula, the window and the parameter set are identical across cells, the only
things that differ between cells of a factorial are the three H4 factors.

```{r metric-fns}
# trailing 7-day mean -> mean annual minimum (extreme low flow)
dec_mam7 <- function(q, dates) {
   roll <- data.table::frollmean(q, n = dec_spell_w)
   yr   <- as.integer(format(dates, "%Y"))
   ym   <- tapply(roll, yr, min, na.rm = TRUE)
   ym   <- ym[is.finite(ym)]
   if (!length(ym)) return(NA_real_)
   mean(ym)
}

# mean annual maximum run of consecutive days below `thr` (persistence);
# an NA day ends a spell, so gaps can only shorten a spell (conservative)
dec_dry_spell <- function(q, dates, thr) {
   yr <- as.integer(format(dates, "%Y"))
   below <- !is.na(q) & q < thr
   per_year <- tapply(below, yr, function(b) {
      r <- rle(as.logical(b))
      if (!any(r$values)) 0L else max(r$lengths[r$values])
   })
   if (!length(per_year)) return(NA_real_)
   mean(per_year)
}

dec_metric_values <- function(q, dates) {
   qv <- q[!is.na(q)]
   if (length(qv) < 365) {
      return(stats::setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(dec_metrics_vec)),
                             dec_metrics_vec))
   }
   q95   <- stats::quantile(qv, dec_q95_prob, names = FALSE, type = 7)
   q90_w <- stats::quantile(qv, dec_q90_prob, names = FALSE, type = 7)
   qmean <- mean(qv)
   mam7  <- dec_mam7(q, dates)
   c(log10_q95     = log10(q95 + dec_log_eps),
     log10_mam7    = if (!is.finite(mam7)) NA_real_ else log10(mam7 + dec_log_eps),
     log10_meanq   = log10(qmean + dec_log_eps),
     lf_ratio_q95  = q95 / max(qmean, dec_log_eps),
     dry_spell_days= dec_dry_spell(q, dates, q90_w))
}

dec_na_reason <- function(metric) {
   data.table::fcase(
      metric %in% c("log10_q95", "log10_meanq", "lf_ratio_q95") ~
         "insufficient_window_days",
      metric == "log10_mam7" ~ "mam7_degenerate",
      metric == "dry_spell_days" ~ "dry_spell_degenerate",
      default = "metric_guard")
}
```

## 5. Simulation core (identical PET / gap rules to HYD_30 and LOWFLOW_00)

```{r sim-fns}
dec_gapfill <- function(x) {
   i_na <- which(is.na(x))
   if (!length(i_na) || all(is.na(x))) return(x)
   x[i_na] <- stats::approx(seq_along(x), x, xout = i_na, rule = 2)$y
   x
}

# read one corrected series (policy-scoped)
dec_read_corrected <- function(policy, gcm, ssp, tier, id, var) {
   fp <- file.path(ssp_dir, paste0("qm_corrected_", policy), gcm, ssp, tier,
                   paste0(id, "_", var, ".csv"))
   if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
   dt <- data.table::fread(fp, select = c("date", "corrected_value", "method_flag"))
   data.table::setnames(dt, c("corrected_value", "method_flag"),
                        c(var, paste0("flag_", var)))
   dt[]
}

# forcing bundle for catchment x gcm x ssp x policy, gap-filled and with PET.
# Gap filling happens ONCE on the full requested span (noleap Feb-29 -> NA):
# pr -> 0 mm (conservative), temperatures -> neighbour interpolation, and the
# filled days are flagged per date so each window can count its own share.
dec_forcing <- function(policy, gcm, ssp, tier, id, lat, keep_dates) {
   pc <- dec_read_corrected(policy, gcm, ssp, tier, id, "pr")
   tx <- dec_read_corrected(policy, gcm, ssp, tier, id, "tasmax")
   tn <- dec_read_corrected(policy, gcm, ssp, tier, id, "tasmin")
   if (is.null(pc) || is.null(tx) || is.null(tn)) return(NULL)

   dt <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "date", all = TRUE),
                list(pc, tx, tn))
   dt[, date := as.Date(date)]
   dt <- dt[date %in% keep_dates]
   data.table::setorder(dt, date)

   dt[, Tmean_C := (tasmax + tasmin) / 2]
   dt[, gap_day := is.na(pr) | is.na(tasmax) | is.na(tasmin) | is.na(Tmean_C)]
   n_gap_total <- sum(dt$gap_day)
   if (n_gap_total) {
      dt[, `:=`(pr     = { v <- dec_gapfill(pr);     v[is.na(v)] <- 0; v },
                tasmax = dec_gapfill(tasmax),
                tasmin = dec_gapfill(tasmin),
                Tmean_C = dec_gapfill(Tmean_C))]
      if (anyNA(dt$Tmean_C)) stop("unfillable input gaps (n=", n_gap_total, ")")
   }
   dt[, PET_mm := airGR::PE_Oudin(
         JD = as.integer(format(date, "%j")), Temp = Tmean_C,
         Lat = lat, LatUnit = "deg")]
   dt[]
}

# run one structure over one window; returns qsim, dates and per-window counters
dec_run_window <- function(dt, w, struct, params) {
   dates_w <- seq(w$warm_start, w$end, by = "day")
   if (!identical(dt$date, dates_w)) {
      stop("forcing dates do not match the window span")
   }

   n_warm <- sum(dates_w < w$start)
   i_warm <- seq_len(n_warm)
   i_run  <- seq.int(n_warm + 1L, length(dates_w))

   FUN <- if (identical(struct, "GR4J")) airGR::RunModel_GR4J
          else airGR::RunModel_GR6J

   inputs <- airGR::CreateInputsModel(FUN_MOD = FUN,
                                      DatesR  = as.POSIXct(dates_w),
                                      Precip  = dt$pr,
                                      PotEvap = dt$PET_mm)
   run_opt <- airGR::CreateRunOptions(FUN_MOD = FUN, InputsModel = inputs,
                                      IndPeriod_WarmUp = i_warm,
                                      IndPeriod_Run    = i_run)
   out <- airGR::RunModel(inputs, run_opt, Param = params, FUN_MOD = FUN)

   w_dt <- dt[i_run]
   flags <- c(w_dt$flag_pr, w_dt$flag_tasmax, w_dt$flag_tasmin)
   list(qsim     = as.numeric(out$Qsim),
        dates    = w_dt$date,
        n_gap    = as.integer(sum(w_dt$gap_day)),
        n_extrap = sum(flags != "within_range", na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

## 6. Run: catchment x policy x gcm x ssp x structure x window

```{r run, eval=TRUE}
rows <- list(); excl <- list()
n_row <- 0L; n_excl <- 0L
t_start <- Sys.time()

# every date needed by any window (the 2061-2080 gap is never requested)
keep_dates <- sort(unique(as.Date(unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(dec_windows)),
   function(k) seq(dec_windows$warm_start[k], dec_windows$end[k], by = "day"))))))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(roster))) {
   id   <- roster$id[i]
   tier <- roster$tier[i]
   lat  <- roster$cwc_lat[i]
   terc <- roster$arid_tercile[i]

   p4 <- readRDS(file.path(hyd_output_dir, "params", paste0(id, ".rds")))$param
   p6 <- readRDS(file.path(gr6j_dir, "params", paste0(id, ".rds")))$param
   par_list <- list(GR4J = p4, GR6J = p6)

   for (k in seq_len(nrow(dec_inv))) {
      pol <- dec_inv$tail_policy[k]; gcm <- dec_inv$gcm[k]; ssp <- dec_inv$ssp[k]
      key <- paste(id, pol, gcm, ssp)

      f <- tryCatch(dec_forcing(pol, gcm, ssp, tier, id, lat, keep_dates),
                    error = function(e) {
                       n_excl <<- n_excl + 1L
                       excl[[n_excl]] <<- data.table::data.table(
                          module = "DECOMP_10", catchment = id,
                          reason_code = "forcing_read_error",
                          detail = paste(key, conditionMessage(e)))
                       NULL
                    })
      if (is.null(f)) next

      for (wd in seq_len(nrow(dec_windows))) {
         w   <- dec_windows[wd]
         sub <- f[date >= w$warm_start & date <= w$end]
         if (nrow(sub) != length(seq(w$warm_start, w$end, by = "day"))) {
            n_excl <- n_excl + 1L
            excl[[n_excl]] <- data.table::data.table(
               module = "DECOMP_10", catchment = id,
               reason_code = "forcing_dates_incomplete",
               detail = paste(key, w$window))
            next
         }

         for (st in dec_structures) {
            sim <- tryCatch(
               dec_run_window(data.table::copy(sub), w, st, par_list[[st]]),
               error = function(e) {
                  n_excl <<- n_excl + 1L
                  excl[[n_excl]] <<- data.table::data.table(
                     module = "DECOMP_10", catchment = id,
                     reason_code = "simulation_error",
                     detail = paste(key, st, w$window, conditionMessage(e)))
                  NULL
               })
            if (is.null(sim)) next

            vals <- dec_metric_values(sim$qsim, sim$dates)[dec_metrics_vec]
            note <- rep(NA_character_, length(vals))
            na_i <- is.na(vals)
            if (any(na_i)) note[na_i] <- dec_na_reason(dec_metrics_vec[na_i])
            n_row <- n_row + 1L
            rows[[n_row]] <- data.table::data.table(
               catchment    = id,
               arid_tercile = terc,
               ssp          = ssp,
               window       = w$window,
               metric       = dec_metrics_vec,
               gcm          = gcm,
               structure    = st,
               tail_policy  = pol,
               value        = round(as.numeric(vals), 6),
               metric_note  = note,
               n_gap_filled        = sim$n_gap,
               extrapolation_share = round(sim$n_extrap / (3 * length(sim$qsim)), 6),
               pr_max_mm           = round(max(sub$pr, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
               metric_version      = dec_metric_version)
         }
      }
   }

   dec_log(sprintf("catchment %s (%d/%d) | rows=%d | elapsed %.1f min",
                   id, i, nrow(roster), n_row,
                   as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "mins"))))
}

dec_metrics_long <- data.table::rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE)
data.table::fwrite(dec_metrics_long, file.path(dec_output_dir, "input_metrics.csv"))

excl_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(excl, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(excl_dt)) {
   data.table::fwrite(excl_dt, dec_excl_fp)
} else if (file.exists(dec_excl_fp)) {
   # a stale exclusions file from an earlier run would be misinformation
   # (guardrail 7: the file must reflect the CURRENT run)
   file.remove(dec_excl_fp)
   cat("stale exclusions file removed (current run had none)\n")
}

cat("rows written:", nrow(dec_metrics_long), "\n")
cat("exclusions logged:", nrow(excl_dt), "\n")
print(dec_metrics_long[, .N, by = .(tail_policy, structure)])
print(dec_metrics_long[, .(n_gcm = data.table::uniqueN(gcm)), by = ssp])
```

## 7. Sanity checks (the H4 grid must be complete and balanced)

```{r checks}
# 1. every catchment x ssp x window cell must carry the full factorial
cells <- dec_metrics_long[, .(n = .N), by = .(catchment, metric, ssp, window)]
cat("cells (catchment x metric x ssp x window):", nrow(cells), "\n")
shape <- dec_metrics_long[, .(n_gcm = data.table::uniqueN(gcm),
                              n_struct = data.table::uniqueN(structure),
                              n_policy = data.table::uniqueN(tail_policy),
                              n = .N),
                          by = .(catchment, metric, ssp, window)]
shape[, balanced := n == n_gcm * n_struct * n_policy]
cat("unbalanced cells:", sum(!shape$balanced), "\n")
print(shape[, .(cells = .N, balanced = sum(balanced),
                n_gcm = paste(sort(unique(n_gcm)), collapse = "/")),
            by = .(ssp, window)])

# 2. no metric may be all-NA for a whole cell
nas <- dec_metrics_long[, .(frac_na = mean(is.na(value))),
                        by = .(metric, ssp, window)]
print(nas[order(-frac_na)][1:8])

# 2b. every NA must carry a reason code (guardrail 7, no silent drops)
stopifnot(all(c("catchment", "arid_tercile", "ssp", "window", "metric", "gcm",
                "structure", "tail_policy", "value", "metric_note",
                "n_gap_filled", "extrapolation_share", "metric_version") %in%
              names(dec_metrics_long)))
stopifnot(all(is.na(dec_metrics_long$value) ==
                 !is.na(dec_metrics_long$metric_note)))
if (anyNA(dec_metrics_long$value))
   print(dec_metrics_long[is.na(value), .N, by = .(metric, metric_note)])

# 3. flag propagation present on every row (AGENTS.md)
stopifnot(!anyNA(dec_metrics_long$n_gap_filled),
          !anyNA(dec_metrics_long$extrapolation_share))
cat("flag columns complete on all rows\n")

# 3b. no nonphysical input may reach the decomposition (tail-fix guard,
#     2026-11-23: the pre-fix linear pr tail reached 4e9 mm/d)
bad_pr <- dec_metrics_long[pr_max_mm > 1000]
cat("rows with pr_max_mm > 1000:", nrow(bad_pr), "\n")
if (nrow(bad_pr)) {
   print(unique(bad_pr[, .(catchment, gcm, ssp, window, tail_policy, pr_max_mm)]))
   stop("nonphysical corrected pr in the H4 input -- fix the upstream tail policy")
}

# 4. explicit record of the GCM set actually used per SSP
gcm_tab <- dec_metrics_long[, .(n_gcm = data.table::uniqueN(gcm),
                                gcms = paste(sort(unique(gcm)), collapse = ";")),
                            by = ssp]
print(gcm_tab[, .(ssp, n_gcm)])
data.table::fwrite(gcm_tab, file.path(dec_output_dir, "h4_gcm_coverage.csv"))
```

## 8. Hand-off

```{r handoff}
writeLines(c(
   "# DECOMP_10 hand-off",
   "",
   paste0("**Run:** ", format(Sys.time()), " | metric_version ", dec_metric_version),
   paste0("**Rows:** ", nrow(dec_metrics_long)),
   paste0("**Catchments:** ", data.table::uniqueN(dec_metrics_long$catchment)),
   paste0("**Policies:** ", paste(sort(unique(dec_metrics_long$tail_policy)), collapse = ", ")),
   paste0("**Structures:** ", paste(sort(unique(dec_metrics_long$structure)), collapse = ", ")),
   paste0("**Windows:** ", paste(sort(unique(dec_metrics_long$window)), collapse = ", ")),
   "",
   "**GCM coverage (explicit, not balanced away):**",
   paste0("- ", gcm_tab$ssp, ": ", gcm_tab$n_gcm, " GCMs"),
   "- HadGEM3-GC31-MM ssp245/ssp370 are unpublished on ESGF",
   "  (`logs/ssp_unavailable.csv`, `gcm_scenario_not_published`); H4 therefore",
   "  runs a 13-GCM factorial for those two SSPs and a 14-GCM factorial for",
   "  ssp126/ssp585. Each is balanced; neither is padded.",
   "",
   "Next: `rmarkdown::render('DECOMP_00_anova.Rmd')` consumes",
   "`data_processed/decomp/input_metrics.csv`."),
   file.path(dec_output_dir, "decomp_10_handoff.md"))

writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()),
           file.path(dec_output_dir, "decomp_10_session_info.txt"))
cat("hand-off written\n")
```

## Take-away

- `input_metrics.csv` is the single factor-tagged table `DECOMP_00` consumes:
  `catchment`, `arid_tercile`, `ssp`, `window`, `metric`, `gcm`, `structure`,
  `tail_policy`, `value`, `metric_note`, `n_gap_filled`,
  `extrapolation_share`, `pr_max_mm`, `metric_version`.
- Every value uses the same calibrated parameters, the same Oudin PET and the
  same one-year warm-up rule -- so the three H4 factors are the only things
  that differ between cells.
- Every `NA` carries a `metric_note` reason code; nothing is dropped silently.
- Nothing is averaged across metrics, and the 13-vs-14 GCM split is written to
  `h4_gcm_coverage.csv` rather than smoothed over.
